chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: The March 1982 reunion concert and touring Japan with Percy Faith
summary: Willard recalls the Santa Monica concert of old colleagues; Callender recalls the 1971 Percy Faith tour of Japan with Alan Robinson.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Of course. It was really enjoyable seeing you at your concert in March '82 here, and it was a grand reunion. There was Gerry Wiggins, there was Bill Douglass...
Well, everybody there was someone you had worked with.

Well, yeah. All of the guys I had worked with at some point before. And the horn player, Alan Robinson, I had first worked with... Well, I had done record dates and studio calls with him, but I worked with him with the Percy Faith Orchestra in '71. We did a tour of Japan. He was one of the horn players. That was a high point, too, because I really enjoy music like Percy Faith's... I like melodic music.
